blocks.text: Network models batate hain ke data ek device se doosre device tak tarteeb se kaise jata hai. Yeh models baat-cheet ko mukhtalif layers (tahon) mein baant dete hain. Data bhejne mein har layer ka khaas kaam hai (jaise Figure 1.13 mein). Layers wale models networks ko samajhna aur sambhalna aasan banate hain. Yeh network ke masail dhoondne (troubleshooting) mein bhi madad dete hain. Network models networking mein standards (maane hue namoone) ke taur par istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Network models pecheeda network baat-cheet ko aasan qadmon mein samajhne ke liye istemal hote hain.

Network layers baat-cheet ke amal ko chhote hisson mein baant deti hain. Har layer ki apni khaas zimmedari hai. Data in layers se qadam ba qadam guzarta hai. Is banawat se network ka design saada aur munazzam (organized) hota hai. Ek layer mein tabdeeli doosri layers par asar nahi karti. Layers wali baat-cheet bharosa aur control behtar karti hai.

OSI ka matlab hai Open Systems Interconnection. Yeh network ki baat-cheet samajhne ka ek standard model hai. OSI model mein saat (7) layers hain. Har layer alag kaam karti hai. Yeh model networks seekhne aur design karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh mukhtalif systems ko sahi tarah baat karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Bhejne wale (sender) ki taraf OSI model: sender computer ke saath saat tahein (layers) oopar se neeche, Application, Presentation, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link aur Physical, neeche ki taraf teeron ke saath; Physical layer se cable nikalti aur tooti lakeer receiver computer tak jati hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 1.13 sirf bhejne wale (sender) ki taraf dikhati hai: data Application layer se neeche Physical layer tak aata hai aur phir cable se jata hai. Receiver (wusool karne wale) par yahi data ulti tarteeb mein, Physical se oopar Application tak, jata hai.
OSI Model ki layers ke kaam

Data ki baat-cheet mein har OSI layer ka khaas kirdar hai. Physical layer kacha data signals ki shakal mein bhejti hai. Data link layer be-ghalti muntaqili (transfer) control karti hai. Network layer data ki routing (raasta chunna) karti hai. Transport layer qabil-e-bharosa delivery yaqeeni banati hai. Session, presentation aur application layers user ke saath baat-cheet aur data ki formatting (shakal dena) mein madad deti hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Neechli layers data ki physical muntaqili sambhalti hain. Darmiyani layers routing aur delivery sambhalti hain. Oopri layers user ki applications ko support karti hain. Har layer alag (independently) kaam karti hai. Mil kar yeh sahi baat-cheet yaqeeni banati hain.
Data ki baat-cheet mein har OSI layer ka khaas kaam hai:

items: Physical Layer: kacha (raw) data bijli, roshni (optical) ya radio signals ki shakal mein medium (taar ya hawa) par bhejti hai. Yeh hardware ki baatein tay karti hai, jaise cables, connectors, voltage levels aur data bhejne ki raftar.

Data Link Layer: seedhe jure hue nodes (devices) ke darmiyan data be-ghalti pohanchati hai. Yeh framing (data ko frames mein band karna), ghalti pakarna aur theek karna, aur mushtarka (shared) medium tak rasai control karti hai.

Network Layer: data ko mukhtalif networks se guzar kar source (bhejne wale) se destination (manzil) tak pohanchane (routing) ki zimmedar hai. Yeh logical addressing (IP addresses) sambhalti aur data ke liye behtareen raasta chunti hai.

Transport Layer: devices ke darmiyan data qabil-e-bharosa aur sahi tarteeb se pohanchati hai. Yeh ghalti ke baad bahali (error recovery), flow control (bahao ki raftar ka control) aur data ko chhote hisson (segments) mein baantne ka kaam karti hai.
Session Layer: applications ke darmiyan baat-cheet ke sessions shuru karti, qaim rakhti aur khatam karti hai. Yeh session checkpoints aur rukawat ki soorat mein bahali sambhalti hai.
Presentation Layer: data ko aisi shakal mein badalti hai jo application layer samajh sake. Yeh encryption (khufia banana), compression (chhota karna) aur format ki tabdeeli karti hai.
Application Layer: users aur applications ko seedhi services deti hai. Yeh HTTP, FTP aur email jaise protocols ko baat-cheet aur data ke len-den ke liye support karti hai.

blocks.prompt: OSI ki saat layers oopar se neeche tak batayein, aur batayein ke IP addresses aur routing kaun si layer sambhalti hai.
blocks.explanation: Application, presentation, session, transport, network, data link, physical. Network layer IP addresses aur routing sambhalti hai.

items: Layers wale models baat-cheet ko alag kaam wali layers mein baant'te hain.
OSI: 7 layers; sender par data Application se Physical tak neeche jata hai.
Physical: signals; Data Link: be-ghalti frames; Network: IP aur routing; Transport: bharose wali delivery; Session: sessions; Presentation: format aur encryption; Application: user services.
